facts.title: About JVM Shyamali
facts.text: Jawahar Vidya Mandir is a co-educational, English-medium school in Shyamali Colony, MECON, Ranchi. Its published profile describes education from Junior KG to Senior Secondary, CBSE affiliation and management by Jawahar Vidya Mandir Education Society, Ranchi.

facts.title: Learning facilities
facts.text: The school's published facilities pages describe computer laboratories, science laboratories for Physics, Chemistry, Biology and Biotechnology, and a library with literature, reference materials, newspapers and magazines. Current access arrangements should be confirmed with the school.

facts.title: Admission information
facts.text: The school publishes an admission-procedure page covering Junior KG and Class XI entry. Current session-specific eligibility, vacancies, deadlines and required documents have not been verified for this exhibition dataset. Check the latest official admission notice before applying; this project does not accept applications.
